hypothesis: A metadata-only selection of 20 dates shared by all 11 supported US cities can yield exactly 220 unique resolved events and a bounded, leakage-safe plan for joining 18-hour market probabilities with prior-day 07Z NBM f41 proxy features.

cohort.selection_rule: Sort dates having exactly one eligible event for every city; choose 20 unique indices round(i*(n-1)/19), i=0..19, from the ordered eligible-date list.

cost_estimate.market_requests: sum of bucket counts only after the event IDs and dates are frozen
cost_estimate.nbm_transfer_bytes: 20 multiplied by the maximum observed full-object byte count in the locked three-date NBM probe

nbm_retrieval.station_duplicate_rule: canonicalize only complete byte-identical duplicates; conflicting duplicates fail

final_join.station_identity: parse exact station from each event resolution URL
final_join.price_vector_normalization: only PRICE_ELIGIBLE complete positive vectors; preserve raw values and raw sum
final_join.proxy_window_metadata: calculate from target_date and locked city IANA timezone
final_join.no_trade_rows: retain without normalized market vector and exclude from later scoring

join_contract.outcome: exactly one terminal winning Polymarket bucket
join_contract.market_vector: complete positive YES vector normalized only after preserving raw values and raw sum

price_history.point_rule: latest valid point at or before end_date_utc minus 18 hours; post-cutoff points forbidden

stages: metadata-only event/date selection and request-volume estimate
frozen prior-day 07Z NBM retrieval and exact-only station extraction

decision_rule.pass: Permit a pre-registered temporal benchmark comparison of NBM proxy probabilities against market probabilities.
decision_rule.fail: Diagnose the failed coverage/cost layer before any model fitting or wider ingestion.
